description: This file is a source code file for a C project, specifically handling menu structures and properties for a configuration system, likely part of a kernel or configuration utility such as kconfig.

classes.name: menu
classes.description: Represents a menu item, which may be a menu, symbol, or other configuration element.

classes.name: property
classes.description: Represents a property associated with menu items or symbols, such as prompts, dependencies, or default values.

classes.name: expr
classes.description: Expression object representing logical conditions or dependencies.

classes.name: symbol
classes.description: Represents a configuration symbol, holding information like name, type, dependencies, and properties.

methods.name: void menu_warn(struct menu * menu,const char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Logs a warning message related to a menu item.

methods.name: void prop_warn(struct property * prop,const char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Logs a warning message related to a property.

methods.name: void menu_add_entry(struct symbol * sym)
methods.description: Creates and adds a new menu entry with a given symbol.

methods.name: struct:menu * menu_add_menu(void)
methods.description: Starts a new submenu and updates internal state.

methods.name: void menu_end_menu(void)
methods.description: Closes the current menu, restoring previous state.

methods.name: void menu_add_dep(struct expr * dep)
methods.description: Adds a dependency expression to the current menu entry.

methods.name: void menu_set_type(int type)
methods.description: Sets the type of the current menu's symbol, with warnings on redefinition.

methods.name: struct:property * menu_add_prop(enum prop_type type,struct expr * expr,struct expr * dep)
methods.description: Adds a property to the current menu entry.

methods.name: struct:property * menu_add_prompt(enum prop_type type,char * prompt,struct expr * dep)
methods.description: Adds a prompt property to the current menu entry.

methods.name: void menu_add_visibility(struct expr * expr)
methods.description: Adds a visibility expression to the current menu entry.

methods.name: void menu_add_expr(enum prop_type type,struct expr * expr,struct expr * dep)
methods.description: Adds an expression property to the current menu.

methods.name: void menu_add_symbol(enum prop_type type,struct symbol * sym,struct expr * dep)
methods.description: Associates a symbol with the current menu entry.

methods.name: int menu_validate_number(struct symbol * sym,struct symbol * sym2)
methods.description: Validates that a symbol's value is a number within accepted types.

methods.name: void sym_check_prop(struct symbol * sym)
methods.description: Checks properties for consistent types and dependencies.

methods.name: void menu_finalize(struct menu * parent)
methods.description: Finalizes a menu, resolving dependencies, types, and validating properties.

methods.name: bool menu_has_prompt(struct menu * menu)
methods.description: Returns true if the menu has a prompt.

methods.name: bool menu_is_empty(struct menu * menu)
methods.description: Checks if a menu is empty or contains only invisible entries.

methods.name: bool menu_is_visible(struct menu * menu)
methods.description: Determines if a menu is currently visible based on dependencies and state.

methods.name: const char * menu_get_prompt(struct menu * menu)
methods.description: Retrieves the prompt string for a menu.

methods.name: struct:menu * menu_get_parent_menu(struct menu * menu)
methods.description: Returns the parent menu of a given menu.

methods.name: bool menu_has_help(struct menu * menu)
methods.description: Returns whether the menu has associated help text.

methods.name: const char * menu_get_help(struct menu * menu)
methods.description: Retrieves the help text for a menu.

methods.name: struct:gstr get_relations_str(struct symbol ** sym_arr,struct list_head * head)

methods.name: void menu_get_ext_help(struct menu * menu,struct gstr * help)
